tup.description: a sequence of arrays to stack; each must have the same shape along all but the third axis. Input arrays will be promoted to at least rank 3. If a single array is given it will be treated equivalently to `tup = unstack(tup)`, but the implementation will avoid explicit unstacking. dtype: optional dtype of the resulting array. If not specified, the dtype will be determined via type promotion rules described in :ref:`type-promotion`.
